title: Ensure 'User Account Control: Admin Approval Mode for the Built-in Administrator account' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\User Account Control: Admin Approval Mode for the Built-in Administrator account to 'Enabled'
reason: Enabling this policy ensures that even the built-in Administrator account must explicitly approve privilege escalation, reducing the risk of malicious software silently gaining full control.

title: Ensure 'User Account Control: Behavior of the elevation prompt for administrators in Admin Approval Mode' is set to 'Prompt for consent on the secure desktop'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\User Account Control: Behavior of the elevation prompt... to 'Prompt for consent on the secure desktop'
reason: Using the secure desktop prevents malicious software from intercepting or mimicking the UAC prompt (spoofing) to trick users into elevating privileges.
